sam: Heads-up — seeing a perf regression on 8xA100 TP=2 PP=4 runs after the kernel-selector patch.
sam: Baseline (pre-2253) stable; post-patch p99 up ~10-20% and throughput down ~15%.
nina: Can you paste the top of the perf trace and the selector logs? :eyes:
sam: quick trace snippet:
```text
PROFILE: step 120
component        compute_ms | comm_ms
------------------------------------
fwd_layer_3      4.2        | 18.9  allreduce wait
fwd_layer_4      3.9        | 19.0
kv_cache_miss    12.7       | 0.2
```
rahul: Allreduce wait spikes look like a channel/proto fallback (LL vs LL128) or algo mismatch — we've seen extra kernel launches add ~15-20ms.
kelsey: We also observed the selector picking proto=LL for some small chunk sizes last week. Interaction with kv-cache prefetch could be skewing timings.
sam: Found relevant runtime log lines:
```
[2026-03-10 14:22:12] kernel-selector: selected proto=LL algo=ring for tensor_shard=3 chunk=256
[2026-03-10 14:22:12] fallback: remap channel->proto mismatch, routing delay 17ms
```
nina: If selector picks ring/LL for those sizes it can kill overlap. Proposal: force LL128+tree for chunk sizes where kv-prefetch latency is dominant and re-run microbench.
rahul: +1. Also instrument perf logs to record per-chunk proto+channel (very low overhead) so we can correlate spikes.
kelsey: I'll add a CI microbench: boot 4g TP/PP config, synthetic batches, sweep kv_cache_miss_ratio {0.0,0.2,0.5} and chunk_sizes {128,256,512}.
sam: For short-term mitigation we can add a heuristic: if kv_cache_miss_rate > 0.2 then prefer LL128+tree for chunk_sizes in [128,512]. That's cheap to flip.
nina: Also add an eval metric for comm/compute overlap % so regressions alert earlier. We should baseline on stable commit and gate the selector change.
infra-bot: deploy/jobs: perf-ci-kv-prefetch-20260311 started (job id: perf-1187) :rocket:
sam: thanks team — will post perf-ci results and raw traces when done. If CI repros, let's coordinate an emergency revert plan.
nina: sounds good. tagging @rahul for kernel-selector changes and @kelsey for perf-ci.
rahul: on it, I'll push logging + a small selector tweak to the branch and link the PR once CI passes. :thumbsup:
sam: awesome — cheers.
